data.name: Iftikhar
data.gender_notes: Iftikhar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Iftikhar is derived from the Arabic word 'iftikhar' which means glory or honor. In Islamic tradition, it signifies the glory of Allah and the honor of being a Muslim. The name Iftikhar carries the meaning “Glory, Honor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Iftikhar usually hope their child will grow to embody glory, honor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Iftikhar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glory, Honor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iftikhar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_urdu.name: افتخار
